Bernie Madoff's victims lost about $20 billion. Almost 18 years later, they have gotten back at least 72.8%.

Madoff ran a Ponzi scheme, paying old investors with new investors' money, until it collapsed in December 2008. In 2009 he was sentenced to 150 years in prison and ordered to forfeit $170.8 billion, most of which was long gone. Court-appointed trustee Irving Picard has recovered about $15.5 billion as of October 23, 2026. After 17 payouts, 1,547 of 2,291 accounts with allowed claims have been paid in full, and every allowed claim has received at least 72.848% (as of February 27, 2026). Sources: Madoff Trustee, US Department of Justice.
